review: M12F integrated timing-skill campaign independent specification review
approval_meaning: Exact-source conditional execution approval for the six registered modes. This does not assert a scientific gain, waive a stage-opening gate, permit a retry, or approve a changed source snapshot.

scope_conditions.F1_search: The audited completed F0 proof, unchanged four interpreter core hashes, frozen study/cases/prompts/history and matching real Torch gate must be bound in the immutable runtime identity before the one registered search allocation. Prior and experienced calls use the same initial parent and matched seeds; only the experienced treatment receives its own causal experience and allowed acceptance bits.
scope_conditions.F1_validation: All three generation-repeat selections and exact consumed search-complete receipt must be sealed before generating the independent validation cohort. Evaluate all eight frozen references; do not change a skill or ranking tool from validation results.
scope_conditions.F1_final: Invoke only if validation TaskGO OR validation ExperienceGO permits opening. Preserve the same consumed search and validation receipt seals; execute all eight frozen references once on the four final seed groups. A confirmed task or experience claim requires that SAME claim to pass validation AND final; switching which claim passes is not registered success.
scope_conditions.F2_adapt: Invoke only after completed F1 validation, F0 proof, the quantitative F1 mechanism gate and resource/source checks. A negative F1 performance result is allowed; positive PPO, prediction, task or experience gains are NOT prerequisites. All three trials start the initial skill on the independent registered cohorts. Only the validated retained protocol transfers; histories, task skills, archives and cross-partition score caches reset.
scope_conditions.F2_validation: All three completed adaptation receipts and their exact ten-method mappings must be captured before independent validation source generation, then rechecked. Keep the fixed3 versus meta3 primary comparison and all strong references.
scope_conditions.F2_final: Invoke only after validation MetaGO and source/safety/resource gates pass. Run BOTH predefined final batches irrespective of their intermediate point verdicts, with no reselection or nominal rescoring. Merge exactly the registered four-seed cohort using exact serialized policy/evaluation identity, and evaluate the final preregistered formula.

operational_conditions: The actual Slurm batch script and mode/trial/batch/source/run-root arguments must be verified while held against the immutable launch identity. Maintain the exclusive per-mode launch claim and never reuse an output directory.

Maximum 75 charged model attempts: F1 at most 18, each of the three conditional F2 search allocations at most 19. Maximum 6000 charged environment attempts, including the 20 completed F0 engineering episodes. Failures, duplicates and malformed responses never grant replacement slots.

Preserve the frozen per-store episode bounds, distinct executor/ranker/skill cache identity and partition boundaries. The F1 actual upper bounds are 680 development, 320 validation and 640 final episodes with shared fixed references; F2 per-repeat bounds are 100 meta, 540 adaptation, 200 validation and 400 final.

At most four one-V100S32GB GPU allocations, at most 90 minutes each and 21600 GPU seconds total; at most two concurrent allocations, 2400 inclusive allocated CPU minutes and 6000000000 new-storage bytes. Include staging, gates, tokenizer checks, model loading, failed setup, audits and all execution in the ledger.

Keep the per-call 6144 input and 1024 output token bounds and 90-second timeout. Persist actual truncated prompts and charge unknown failed output usage at the upper bound. Any model/runtime/source/safety/resource failure stops the campaign; no rescue allocation or free retry.

A normal negative performance or mechanism result remains a negative result. Do not invoke a closed final mode. No old private final data, new neural training, hard-kernel modification, extra candidates or outcome-driven threshold/seed changes are authorized.
closed_findings: Repeated equal proposal histories now retain their actual slot indices rather than using value-based list.index chronology.
Final batch merging distinguishes legal numeric JSON representations such as 0 and 0.0 by exact serialized policy identity.
A valid but unchanged meta protocol cannot be retained as a protocol update.
The exact consumed F1 search receipt and validation receipt are sealed along with the mapping files, rather than sealing unused duplicate representations alone.
All three F2 adaptation receipts are sealed before validation generation and rechecked after confirmation.
Registered F1 final success requires matching validation/final claim conjunctions, not an OR over different phase winners.

Deterministic experience-card ordering exposes one card per profession before optional contrasts, and the mechanism gate checks professions actually sent to the model, not merely available in storage.
result_delivery_requirement: After execution, independently audit actual call receipts, hidden-information boundaries, retention decisions, mappings, raw-event arithmetic, resource accounting and all supported scientific claims. This source review does not substitute for that result audit.
